# UPD-001: Automatic security updates are enabled

- **Group:** Updates
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Most compromises of patched-upstream bugs happen in the weeks after a fix is published. unattended-upgrades closes that window without you, but only when the package is installed, APT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade is on and apt-daily-upgrade.timer is enabled.

## Verify by hand

```sh
dpkg -s unattended-upgrades; apt-config dump APT::Periodic; systemctl is-enabled apt-daily-upgrade.timer
```

## How to fix it

apt install unattended-upgrades; dpkg-reconfigure -plow unattended-upgrades

## What a fix can break

Packages update and services restart on their own, mostly at night.

Run `stackward explain UPD-001` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
